title: A refined blow-up analysis of the Brezis-Nirenberg equation and its application: The one-bubble case for $N\geq4$
summary: In this paper, we consider the famous Brezis-Nirenberg equation \begin{eqnarray*} \left\{ \aligned &-Δu=λu+|u|^{\frac{4}{N-2}}u,\quad&\mbox{in}\,\, Ω,\\ &u=0,\quad&\mbox{on}\,\, \partialΩ, \endaligned \right. \end{eqnarray*} where $N\geq3$ is the dimension, $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^N$ is a bounded domain with smooth boundary $\partialΩ$ and $λ>0$ is a parameter.
